# Official WikiSQL evaluator (vendored, unmodified)

Copied verbatim from https://github.com/salesforce/WikiSQL (master branch, fetched 2026-10-13): `evaluate.py`, `lib/dbengine.py`, `lib/query.py`, `lib/common.py`.
